title: Pass 5: Validate, Publish, Build Community
description: Validate on physical FPGA, publish papers, build community around miniKanren 1-bit hardware acceleration

ordering_chirho: Truth before speed: verify before proclaiming performance
Measured > estimated: prefer post-route/on-FPGA evidence over generic synthesis
Scope clarity: FD-miniKanren kernel vs full miniKanren semantics (reference engine)
Reproducibility: every headline metric has an evidence pointer and a command to reproduce
Stewardship: community/outreach grows from demonstrated truth, not hype

naming_convention_chirho.description: All project identifiers use the _chirho suffix to glorify God. See /suffix-review-chirho skill.
naming_convention_chirho.divine_header_chirho: All source files begin with: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son that all who believe in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.
exceptions_chirho: Third-party product names in prose (AWS, FPGA, GH200, SICStus, Gecode)
Standard benchmark names in prose (N-Queens, Sudoku, Graph Coloring)
Code examples in docs MUST use _chirho for our identifiers

headline_result.description: Post-route timing achieved 280 MHz on Xilinx VU9P with Vivado 2024.2 (build environment).

metrics.validated_on: AWS F1 c5.4xlarge dev instance (post-route, not on-FPGA)

caveats: Throughput 35M unify/sec is projected from timing, not measured on physical FPGA

Vivado `check_timing` flagged missing I/O delays for many ports; internal timing closure is meaningful under the current constraints, but I/O constraints must be defined for the real integration boundary
Utilization percentages are approximate without hierarchical utilization context
On-FPGA validation with AFI bitstream is pending (this is the main remaining proof)

verification_gap.description: The 'Truth' (Rust reference) and 'Power' (Clash/Calyx hardware) must be verified bit-identical for the FD-miniKanren kernel command/response semantics.
verification_gap.missing_link: Co-simulation harness to drive the same command stream into (a) Rust model and (b) Verilog simulation (Verilator), then assert identical responses and state transitions.
verification_gap.action_required: Build a Verilator-driven test harness; fuzz the kernel subset (proptest or equivalent) and assert exact agreement: assert_eq!(rust_resp_chirho, hw_resp_chirho).

milestone_path.description: From recommendations_pass5_chirho.md: The wisest path to unbounded accelerator

milestones.name: Golden FPGA Demo
milestones.description: Pick N-Queens or Sudoku, run end-to-end, verify bit-identical to Rust for the bounded kernel semantics, and record measured on-FPGA throughput/latency.

milestones.name: Unbounded Search (State Spilling)
milestones.description: External work queue in DRAM, FPGA processes batches of states

milestones.name: Unbounded Terms (External Hash-Consing)
milestones.description: Small on-chip cache, backing store in DRAM/host

milestones.name: Scale Variables/Domains (Paged Representations)
milestones.description: Substitution in DRAM, FPGA caches hot slices; paged bitsets for domains >64

milestones.name: Host-Managed Tabling
milestones.description: Host does SLG completion/scheduling, FPGA does propagation inner loop

cautions.description: From recommendations_pass5_chirho.md: What NOT to claim
items: Don't claim 'fully unbounded in pure hardware' - not possible with finite BRAM/FF/LUT
Don't claim vendor utilization percentages without vendor mapping (Vivado/Quartus)
Don't conflate 'kernel unification as AND' with 'full structural unification' without finite-domain qualifier
